name: bumper_hit_lockout
description: bumper_hit with the sensor lockout poked to 3: in EP5 the sensor lockout and the kicker cooldown are one byte (ds:43DE: dec cs:06FE, kicker test cs:141A, kicker sets 4 cs:1533, sensor handlers set 1/3/15 cs:1AC4..1D5F), so the first kicker contact within 3 frames does not kick.
